_about: Where MyDegreePlan is ALLOWED to behave differently on its three platforms (web, desktop = the Windows app, docker). Everything else must be identical, because all three run the same Frontend bundle. src/tests/platformBranches.test.js fails when a source file branches on the platform or backend without being listed here, or a listed file stops doing so. To add a branch: decide it is really needed, add it with a reason, and say which platforms differ. 'words' = only the wording differs (put it in lib/platform.js); 'feature' = a capability exists on some platforms only; 'infrastructure' = the code that detects the platform or talks to its backend.

src/lib/platform.js.why: Decides which platform this is, and holds every platform-specific word.

src/lib/dataClient.js.why: Picks the data backend and exports the platform.

src/lib/data/remoteClient.js.why: The supabase-js client for the Docker stack's API.

src/lib/brand.js.why: Institution wording; the Docker config can override it (brand: 'neutral' for demos).

src/components/ErrorBoundary.jsx.why: The reload wording: the desktop app has no page to reload.

src/components/shell/DeviceDataCard.jsx.why: Where the plan lives (browser / computer / install), and the Erase button's label.

src/components/shell/Sidebar.jsx.why: Accounts: the Docker install shows the signed-in email and a Sign out button; web and desktop have one implicit user ('On this device').

src/lib/actScores.js.why: The recovery hint after a failed reload of degree data.

src/lib/desktopUpdate.js.why: Reads the Windows app's update bridge (window.mdpDesktop.updates).

src/lib/useDesktopUpdate.js.why: The hook behind the desktop update card.

src/lib/updateStatus.js.why: Talks to the Docker install's updater service.

src/lib/useAppUpdate.js.why: The hook behind the Docker update banner.

accounts.note: Login, Signup and Sign out. On web and desktop there is one implicit user and the pages are never shown.

docker-update-banner.note: Update now / required / progress banner for the Docker install.

desktop-update-card.note: Download / Restart now card for the Windows app (renders nothing without its bridge).
